title: Python Foundations: Build a Research Tool
description: Learn by building a small, tested evidence organizer from first principles.

lessons.title: Values and Variables
lessons.objective: Store and inspect a piece of evidence safely.

lessons.title: Functions and Boundaries
lessons.objective: Turn repeated work into a reusable function.
lessons.check: python -c "def normalize(value): return value.strip().lower(); assert normalize(' Claim ') == 'claim'"

lessons.title: Collections and Records
lessons.objective: Represent multiple evidence records and find one by title.

lessons.title: Tests as Proof
lessons.objective: Write a test that catches a broken evidence transformation.
